remark: Caught SecurityException from connectivityManager.getActiveNetwork() and connectivityManager.getNetworkCapabilities() calls, returning false on exception.
analysis: The method checks internet connectivity validation using ConnectivityManager. First, it returns true if SDK version <24. Otherwise, it calls connectivityManager.getActiveNetwork() which may throw a SecurityException if the app lacks ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE permission. If activeNetwork is null, it returns false; if not null, it calls connectivityManager.getNetworkCapabilities(activeNetwork), which may also throw SecurityException. Both are runtime exceptions. Since the method is likely used in contexts where permissions might not be granted, catching SecurityException here is advisable to avoid crashes and handle gracefully by returning false.
